requirements: Is there exactly one tiny taco figurine shown?
Is the taco centered and filling about 70 percent of the picture with empty margin on all sides?
Does the taco appear to be made of solid glazed pottery with a hard shiny cream glaze?
Are there small brown speckles visible on the cream glaze?
Is the taco shell and filling made from the same smooth glazed clay material?
Does the filling consist of a few rounded bumps that are glazed green and red?
Is a silver paperclip visibly stuck into the top of the taco?
Is the entire object clearly depicted as a clay ornament rather than real food?
Is the view a three-quarter angle from slightly above?
Are there no people, hands, faces, or any additional objects present?
